# T2 — Level accuracy of imputed cells against later survey values (Task 2.2, levels)

*Generated by `analysis/notes.py` from `outputs/tables/T2_levels.csv`.*

**Claim.** On clean hold-out cells (imputed in one release, surveyed later, value confirmed by the WFP feed), RTFP's imputed price levels are close to the later survey value on average: mean absolute error 2.9–6.5% and median 1.7–4.2% across items and strata, with mean log bias between -1.5% and 1.6%. Share of cells off by more than 10%: 4–10%.

**Level correlation tracks the price spread more than accuracy.** On toggle cells spanning 2007–2024 the correlation of log levels is 0.97–0.99 (similar to the 0.94–0.99 reported for Nigeria by Adewopo et al. 2025), while on the clean recent cells it is 0.36–0.86, with MAPE 2.70–3.75% (toggle) vs 2.88–6.49% (clean). Toggle cells are not an out-of-sample test (their survey value was already in an earlier release), so this comparison illustrates how long trends inflate level correlations; it is not a like-for-like accuracy comparison.

**Cross-market calibration.** The month-demeaned level Mincer–Zarnowitz slope (survey on imputed) is 0.57–1.11; below 1 means a given imputed difference between markets is followed, on average, by a smaller surveyed difference, so imputed cross-market differences are only partly real. The imputed cross-market spread is itself smaller than the surveyed spread in 8 of 8 cells (SD ratio imputed/survey 0.49–0.81); since slope = correlation ÷ SD ratio, slopes below 1 come from the weak month-demeaned correlation (0.34–0.72), not from excess imputed dispersion.

**Published high/low band.** The later survey value lies inside the imputing release's [l_, h_] band in 41–61% of clean cells (band half-width ≈ 1.8–2.5%).

**Method.** Truth = latest-release survey value (equals the WFP feed, Table A1). Imputed value = `c_final` (last release before the survey value appeared). CIs: two-way (market × month) pigeonhole bootstrap, 500 draws.

**Caveats.** Exploratory (pre-registration). Clean cells cover price months 2023-09 to 2026-08 only. The forecast stratum (no market observed in the imputing release's month) dominates the sample.

**Files.** `outputs/tables/T2_levels.csv`; script `analysis/t2_levels.py`.
